{"turns": [
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "hi, i need help with my bill. its way too high this month!! 😡", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "Hello! Thanks for contacting Nimbus Telecom. I'm Sana. How can I help you today?", "tags": ["greeting"]},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "my bill is like 20 dollars more than usual. i dont know why it's so expensive", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "I'm sorry to hear that you're frustrated with the bill amount. I can definitely look into this for you.", "tags": ["empathy"]},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "Before we dive in, could you please provide your account number and full name for verification?", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "Sure, my name is Vivek Reddy and my account number is 32252095", "tags": ["identity_verification"]},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "Thank you, Mr. Reddy. Let me check the charges. One moment please.", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "i just want to know why i was charged for a movie rental that i didnt even watch", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "I see the charge here. It looks like a mistake in the system. I will raise a refund request for the wrong charge now.", "tags": ["action:refund_request"]},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "thanks, i just hate it when these things happen", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "I understand. Please note that the refund is subject to approval and will typically appear in your account within 7-10 business days.", "tags": ["disclosure"]},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "ok, that sounds fair. thanks for fixing it so fast!", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "You're very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today? I've submitted the request, and you'll get an email confirmation soon. Goodbye!", "tags": ["closure"]}
]}
